definitions.explanation: To press and fold dough or similar substances repeatedly to make them smooth and pliable.
To make petty complaints or arguments (often in the form {理屈|りくつ}を{捏|こ}ねる).

examples.japanese: パン{生地|きじ}を{捏|こ}ねる。
{粘土|ねんど}をよく{捏|こ}ねてから{形|かたち}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: Knead the clay well before shaping it.

examples.japanese: {屁理屈|へりくつ}を{捏|こ}ねないで。

notes:
USAGE: {捏|こ}ねる is an ichidan verb used primarily in cooking and crafting contexts.

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive (takes を)

ASPECT: {捏|こ}ねている indicates ongoing kneading action or habitual kneading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{生地|きじ}を{捏|こ}ねる (to knead dough)
・{粘土|ねんど}を{捏|こ}ねる (to knead clay)
・{理屈|りくつ}を{捏|こ}ねる (to quibble, make excuses)
・{屁理屈|へりくつ}を{捏|こ}ねる (to nitpick, make sophistic arguments)

KANJI NOTE: The kanji {捏|こ}ねる uses a relatively uncommon character. Often written in hiragana as こねる in casual contexts.

RELATED:
・{練|ね}る - to knead, to train, to refine
・{混|ま}ぜる - to mix
